\[ P = 2L \cdot \lambda L^\nu = 2\lambda L^{\nu+1} \, \text{Coulombs/Newton} \]
\[ P = 2 \times 10^{-5} \times (0.0034)^{1.7} / \exp(0.0002 \times 0.0034) \approx 2 \times 10^{-5} \times 0.0034^{1.7} / \exp(0.00068) \approx 2 \times 10^{-5} \times 0.000406 / 1.00068 \approx 2 \times 10^{-5} \times 0.000405 \approx 81 \times 10^{-9} \, \text{Coulombs/Newton} \]
